mode: Read-only static official APK recovery; no account or device operations

sources.evidence: SerializedName notification_v18/feedlike; standard property message; three distinct int counters
Recovered update routine assigns notification from getNotificationV18, feedLike from getFeedLike, pm from getMessage; does not use getBadgeV18
Login required. notification + feedLike, optionally pm when containMessage=true. If notification_ignore_like_count is true subtract feedLike, then clamp at zero.

limitations: The server also exposes badge_v18 but the recovered native routine never uses it for this calculation; do not assume it includes or excludes likes.
Keep individual like counts intact. This preference changes the aggregate homepage number only.
If notification_v18/feedlike are absent, an aggregate-only server response cannot establish an exact subtraction. Do not subtract a guessed count.
Cloud settings subscription does not establish Windows background delivery. Android update/install notification controls remain phone cooperation.
